remarks: Experience exceptional Westport living at 282 North Avenue, a beautifully maintained estate offering nearly 8,000 sq. ft. of living space on over 2 private acres. This impressive 7-bedroom, 8+ bath home features bright, spacious interiors, multiple living and entertaining areas, and a private outdoor setting with pool. Can be furnished if needed, and the home provides an easy, largely turnkey move while still allowing space for a tenant's own furnishings. Recently refreshed and meticulously maintained with a new hot water heater, serviced HVAC and appliances, updated pool equipment, and fresh paint. Conveniently located near downtown Westport, beaches, dining, shopping, and Metro-North. Available early November. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy one of Westport's premier rental properties through the holiday season! *Please note, photos were taken prior to current tenant.
